rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for low-budget travel with only a backpack or minimal luggage.

example.english: We’re backpacking this time, so we’ll keep our spending down.
example.traditional: 我哋今次背囊旅行，會慳住使。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 bui3 nong4 leoi5 hang4 wui5 haan1 zyu6 sai2

rows.note: Use this specifically for backpacking understood as hiking in the countryside and camping overnight.

example.english: We’re going backpacking in the hills and camping this Saturday, so we’re bringing all our food and sleeping bags.
example.traditional: 我哋星期六去行山露營，帶齊食物同睡袋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 heoi3 haang4 saan1 lou6 jing4 daai3 cai4 sik6 mat6 tung4 seoi6 doi6
